messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.5.5 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

A new point release in the 2.5.x series is available and on pypi.
The most significant fix is a segfault that could occur when using
annotation packages in the latest bioconductor release.

The changelog is:

Release 2.5.5
=============

Bugs fixed
----------

- Crash (segfault) when querying an R object in an R environment triggers an
  error (symbol exists, but associated values resolves to an error - issue
#251)

- Change in the signature of `rcall` was not updated in the documentation
  (issue #259)

- Minor update to the documentation (issue #257)



Laurent
